verdict.rationale: Tailscale SSH has Tailscale handle SSH authentication and authorization across the tailnet, which implies connecting to hosts without re-entering credentials. Community users describe SSH'ing into their machines with little friction, and first-party testimonials do the same. However, Tailscale is a connectivity layer, not an SSH client, and nothing in the evidence shows a saved-host list or a one-tap connect action. Missing for 10: saved-host/bookmark management, one-tap connect UI, documented credential-free reconnect flow, independent hands-on corroboration of the full story.
